note: 介面文字。每個 key 一組 zh／en。頁面同時載入兩種語言，靠切換鈕換——分成兩份產出的話 Artifact 數量會加倍，每份都要單獨設分享權限。

cat_both.en: Both bushfire and disaster recovery count

detail_empty.en: Tap any postcode on the map, or search above, to see whether it counts and which kind of work qualifies.
detail_empty.zh: 點地圖上任一塊郵區，或在上面輸入郵遞區號，這裡會顯示這個郵區算不算集簽、哪一種工作算。

dev_banner.en: Development build — data and verdicts may be wrong. Stable version:
dev_banner.zh: 開發版 · 資料與判定可能不正確，正式版請看

disclaimer.en: This is not an official government site. Boundaries are generalised ABS data, for orientation only. Check the official Home Affairs page again before you apply.
disclaimer.zh: 本站非官方網站。郵區界線為 ABS 概化資料，僅供判讀；送件前請再上 Home Affairs 官網確認一次。

fact1_body.zh: {ind}在 {tables} 郵區內的工作才算集簽。

fact1_head.en: The area list depends on your industry.

fact2_body.en: In a declared disaster area, recovery work — earthworks, demolition, repairs, roads and bridges — counts even if the postcode is not on the lists above. Volunteering counts too. Ordinary work in the same postcode does not.
fact2_body.zh: 被宣告為災區的郵區，就算不在上面那些名單裡，做災後重建的土建、拆除、修繕、道路橋樑一樣算，志工也算。但同一個郵區的一般工作不算。

fact2_head.en: Disaster areas are a separate route.

fact3_body.en: Counted as full-time equivalent days. You cannot compress them into less than 3 or 6 calendar months.
fact3_body.zh: 算的是等同全職的工作天數，不能壓縮在比 3 個月／6 個月更短的期間內完成。

fact3_head.en: 88 days for a second visa, 179 for a third.
fact3_head.zh: 二簽 88 天、三簽 179 天。

hits_more.en: — showing the first {n}; type more to narrow it down
hits_more.zh: ，只列出前 {n} 筆，再打幾個字縮小範圍

hits_none.en: No match for "{q}". Try a postcode, or just the first few letters of a place.
hits_none.zh: 找不到「{q}」。試試郵遞區號，或只打地名的前幾個字。

hits_other.en: {n} more in other states — tap to open that state’s map.
hits_other.zh: 其他州還有 {n} 筆，點下去會跳到那一州的地圖。

legend_note.en: One list at a time. Looking up a single postcode still shows every route in full, regardless of this setting.
legend_note.zh: 一次只看一張表。查單一郵區時三條路徑都會完整列出，不受這裡影響。

map_reg_sub.en: This area covers {n} postcodes; everything else is dimmed. Tap any one for its verdict.
map_reg_sub.zh: 這個行政區涵蓋 {n} 個郵區，其餘郵區已淡化。點任一塊看它的判定。

map_src.en: This map covers 417 (Working Holiday) only; 462 has different industry rules and is not represented. The postcode lists are taken verbatim from {ha} (the page states it was last updated {date}). Boundaries are ABS Postal Areas 2021 generalised outlines — for orientation only, not legal boundaries. Check the extent and dates of individual disaster declarations against {da}. Always go by the official page before you apply.
map_src.zh: 本圖只處理 417（Working Holiday）；462 的產業規則不同，不適用。郵遞區號清單逐字取自 {ha}（頁面標示更新於 {date}）。郵區範圍為 ABS Postal Areas 2021 概化邊界，僅供判讀，非法定界線；個別災害的宣告範圍與日期請對 {da} 查證。送件前務必以官方頁面為準。

map_stamp.en: Postcode lists: Home Affairs {d} · Boundaries: ABS POA 2021 · Built {b}
map_stamp.zh: 郵區清單 Home Affairs {d} · 邊界 ABS POA 2021 · 建置 {b}

map_strays.en: {n} eligible postcodes have no ABS boundary (mostly PO Box ranges) and are shown as dots.
map_strays.zh: 有 {n} 個合格郵區在 ABS 沒有對應面（多為信箱型郵區），以小點標示。

map_title.en: Map of postcodes where 417 specified work counts in {state}. {n} postcodes. Use the “Postcode or place” field on the left to look up an individual postcode.
map_title.zh: {state} 417 集簽合格郵遞區號地圖，共 {n} 個郵區。用左側「查郵區或地名」欄位查詢個別郵區。

not_assistance.en: This site does not provide immigration assistance. For advice on your own case, consult a registered migration agent (MARA) or a legal practitioner.
not_assistance.zh: 本站不構成移民協助（immigration assistance），個案問題請洽註冊移民代辦（MARA）或法律執業者。

p_also_declared.en: This postcode is also a declared disaster area: {list}.

p_au_title.en: Map of Australian states and territories. States with a map are clickable; the rest are shown for reference.
p_au_title.zh: 澳洲各州地圖導覽。有做地圖的州可以點進去，其餘僅供參考。

p_basis_lede.en: The Home Affairs page carries five separate postcode lists. Each industry maps to one or more of them — so which places count depends entirely on the work you do.
p_basis_lede.zh: Home Affairs 的頁面上有五張各自獨立的郵區表。每個產業各自對應到其中一張或幾張——所以「哪裡算集簽」完全取決於你做什麼行業。

p_basis_note2.en: The "Scope" column below summarises the official definitions and examples. When in doubt, go by {link}.
p_basis_note2.zh: 下表的「範圍」是官方定義與例示的中文摘要，不是官方文字。判斷不確定時請以 {link} 為準。

p_card_note_all.en: The whole state is on the area list that applies to {ind}, so work anywhere counts and no map is needed. {w} postcodes.
p_card_note_all.zh: 整個州都在{ind}適用的地區名單上，在哪裡工作都算，所以不需要地圖。共 {w} 個郵區。

p_card_note_few.en: Ordinary {ind} work counts in only {w} {unit}; everywhere else, only disaster recovery work counts.
p_card_note_few.zh: 一般{ind}工作只有 {w} {unit}算，其餘只有災後重建工作算。

p_card_note_none.en: Ordinary {ind} work never counts here. But the whole territory is a declared disaster area, so recovery work counts anywhere in it.
p_card_note_none.zh: 一般{ind}工作在這裡都不算。但全境被宣告為災區，災後重建工作在哪裡都算。

p_disclaim.en: This is not an official government site. Boundaries are generalised ABS data, for orientation only. Check {link} again before you apply.
p_disclaim.zh: 本站非官方網站。郵區界線為 ABS 概化資料，僅供判讀；送件前請再上 {link} 確認一次。

p_hint.en: {n} postcodes searchable, covering all of Australia. {m} states have maps so far.
p_hint.zh: 可查 {n} 個郵遞區號，涵蓋全澳。目前有 {m} 個州做了地圖。

p_hits_tail.en: Tap one to see the verdict.

p_nf_pc.en: No postcode {pc}. It may be a PO Box range, or a number Australia Post has never issued.
p_nf_pc.zh: 找不到郵遞區號 {pc}。可能是信箱型號碼，或這個號碼澳洲郵政沒有發行。

p_nomap_line.en: There is no map for {state} yet. The verdict above still applies.
p_nomap_line.zh: {state}還沒做地圖。上面的判斷仍然有效。

p_none_sub.en: This postcode is not on any of the eligible lists.
p_none_sub.zh: 這個郵區不在任何一張合格清單上。

p_note1_b.en: Construction counts only inside Regional Australia postcodes. Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane and the Gold Coast are not on the list.
p_note1_b.zh: 建築業在 Regional Australia 郵區內的工作才算集簽。雪梨、墨爾本、布里斯本、黃金海岸這些都會區的郵區不在名單上。

p_note2_b.en: In a declared disaster area, recovery work — earthworks, demolition, repairs, roads and bridges — counts even if the postcode is not on the regional list. Volunteering counts too. Ordinary new-build work in the same postcode does not.
p_note2_b.zh: 被宣告為災區的郵區，就算不在 regional 名單裡，做災後重建的土建、拆除、修繕、道路橋樑一樣算，志工也算。但同一個郵區的一般新建案不算。

p_note2_h.en: Disaster areas are a separate route

p_note3_b.en: This site covers 417 (Working Holiday). The area lists for 462 (Work and Holiday) are currently identical, but the industry rules are not — 462 has no mining category, and fishing and forestry are limited to Northern Australia. If you hold a 462, do not rely on the verdicts here.
p_note3_b.zh: 本站處理的是 417（Working Holiday）。462（Work and Holiday）的地區表雖然目前跟 417 相同，但產業規則不同——462 沒有礦業這一項，漁業與林業只限 Northern Australia。拿 462 的人不要照這裡判斷。

p_note4_b.en: This site covers 417 (Working Holiday) only. The postcode lists are taken verbatim from {ha}. Check the extent and dates of individual disaster declarations against {da}. Always go by the official page before you apply.
p_note4_b.zh: 本站只處理 417（Working Holiday）。郵區清單逐字取自 {ha}。個別災害的宣告範圍與日期請對 {da} 查證。送件前務必以官方頁面為準。

p_prov1.en: The five postcode lists — parsed verbatim from the Home Affairs page, not retyped by hand. The date shown is the date the official page itself carries.
p_prov1.zh: 五張郵區表——從 Home Affairs 頁面逐字解析，不是人工轉錄。頁面上標的日期就是官網自己的更新日期。

p_prov2.en: Postcode boundaries — the Australian Bureau of Statistics’ official ASGS 2021 Postal Areas generalised layer.
p_prov2.zh: 郵區邊界——ABS（澳洲統計局）官方 ASGS 2021 Postal Areas 概化圖層。

p_prov3.en: The industry mapping — the one part compiled by hand. The official page states it in prose ("construction in regional Australia"), never as a table, so it was read and transcribed item by item.
p_prov3.zh: 產業對應表——這是唯一人工整理的部分。官網把它寫成散文（「construction in regional Australia」這種句子），沒有做成表，所以是我讀了逐條整理的。

p_prov4.en: The three verdicts (counts / recovery only / does not count) are computed from the two sources above. They are not a separate dataset.
p_prov4.zh: 三分類（就算／只有重建算／不算）——由上面兩者算出來的，不是另一份資料。

p_q_aria.en: Enter a postcode or place name

p_rebuild_sub.en: Ordinary {ind} work does not count. Recovery earthworks, demolition, repairs, roads and bridges do, and volunteering counts too. Keep records showing the work was disaster repair.
p_rebuild_sub.zh: 一般{ind}工作不算。重建的土建、拆除、修繕、道路橋樑才算，志工也算，記得留下能證明工程屬於災後修復的紀錄。

p_reg_all_rebuild.en: Only disaster recovery work counts anywhere in this area — ordinary {ind} work does not.
p_reg_all_rebuild.zh: 整個區域都只有災後重建工作算，一般{ind}工作不算。

p_reg_all_work.en: Ordinary {ind} work counts everywhere in this area.
p_reg_all_work.zh: 整個區域的一般{ind}工作都算。

p_reg_found.en: "{q}" matches {n} local government areas. Pick one to see the postcodes it covers.
p_reg_found.zh: 「{q}」對到 {n} 個行政區。點一個看它涵蓋哪些郵區。

p_reg_lead.en: This is a local government area, not a postcode. Eligibility is decided postcode by postcode, so every postcode it covers is listed below.
p_reg_lead.zh: 這是行政區名，不是郵區。合格與否是一個郵區一個郵區認定的，所以下面列出它涵蓋的每一個。

p_reg_mixed.en: Verdicts differ within this area — it depends which postcode.
p_reg_mixed.zh: 這個區域內的判定不一致，要看是哪一個郵區。

p_route_fire.zh: 叢林大火重建（2019/7/31 之後）

p_route_flood.zh: 洪水／氣旋等天災重建（2021/12/31 之後）

p_samelist.en: {same} use the same Regional Australia list as construction, so the verdicts are identical — this map works just as well for farm, meatworks and mine workers. Tourism and hospitality differs most: it uses Remote and Northern, leaving just {tour} usable postcodes against Regional’s {reg} — roughly {ratio} times fewer.
p_samelist.zh: {same}跟建築吃同一張 Regional Australia 表，判斷完全相同——所以這張地圖對做農場、肉廠、礦區的人一樣有效。觀光餐旅差最多：它看的是 Remote 與 Northern，可用郵區只有 {tour} 個，不到 Regional（{reg} 個）的 {ratio} 分之一。

p_stamp.en: Postcode lists: Home Affairs {d} · Boundaries: ABS/open data · Built {b}
p_stamp.zh: 郵區清單 Home Affairs {d} · 州界 ABS/公開資料 · 建置 {b}

subtitle.zh: 郵遞區號合格性與災區宣告

tbl_disaster.en: Official table: Natural disaster declared areas

tropic.zh: TROPIC OF CAPRICORN 南回歸線

v_fire.zh: 叢林大火重建工作 → 算

v_fire_sub.en: Rebuilding, demolition, land clearing and repairs carried out after 31 July 2019. Paid or volunteer.
v_fire_sub.zh: 2019 年 7 月 31 日之後執行的重建、拆除、整地、修繕，有給薪或志工都算。

v_flood.en: Flood, cyclone and severe weather recovery → counts
v_flood.zh: 洪水／氣旋等天災重建工作 → 算

v_flood_sub.en: Carried out after 31 December 2021. Select "flood recovery" as Employment type when you apply.
v_flood_sub.zh: 2021 年 12 月 31 日之後執行；申請時「Employment type」要選 flood recovery。

v_no_polygon.en: The ABS has no boundary for this postcode; it is shown as a dot at an approximate location.
v_no_polygon.zh: ABS 沒有這個郵區的對應面，地圖上以小點標示概略位置。

v_not_listed.en: Postcode {pc}{where} is not on any eligible list for {state}. Neither ordinary {ind} work nor recovery work counts here.
v_not_listed.zh: 郵遞區號 {pc}{where} 不在{state}的合格清單上。一般{ind}工作與災後重建工作都不能用它集簽。

v_rebuild_only.en: Note: recovery work is the only route here. Ordinary {ind} work unrelated to disaster recovery does not count. Keep records showing the work was disaster repair.
v_rebuild_only.zh: 注意：這個郵區只走災後重建這條路。一般{ind}工作、跟災後復原無關的，不能算。留好能證明工程屬於災後修復的紀錄。

v_work_no_sub.en: This postcode is not on the area list that applies to {ind}.
v_work_no_sub.zh: 這個郵區不在{ind}適用的地區名單上。

v_work_yes_sub.en: This postcode is on the area list that applies to {ind}.
v_work_yes_sub.zh: 這個郵區在{ind}適用的地區名單上。
